# Humanloop

Humanloop helps developers build and refine AI applications, offering user feedback loops, model training, and data annotation to iterate on language model performance

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/humanloop/.

## Actions

- **Create Project**: This tool creates a new project in humanloop.
- **Delete Project**: This tool allows you to delete a specific project from your humanloop organization.
- **List Experiments** (read-only): This tool retrieves an array of experiments associated with a specific project in humanloop.
- **List Sessions** (read-only): This tool retrieves a paginated list of sessions for a specific project in humanloop.
